top_story.headline: No new FEC compliance filings surfaced since the last edition
top_story.dek: All 250 RFAI and Form 99 filings in the three-day window were already reported in earlier editions.
paragraphs: The scripts found 250 FEC RFAI and Form 99 filings received since October 21, 2026, and every one of them has already appeared in a prior edition. No new RFAI letters, Form 99 correspondence, terminations or red-flag keyword hits are left to report.

The voided and negative transaction check returned no new rows. The FEC Schedule A query for negative amounts of $10,000 or more timed out (HTTP 504), so that section could not be checked this run and is not a finding of 'none.'

sections.headline: $87,500 in new independent expenditures
paragraphs: 1 new independent expenditures of $50K or more, $87,500 in all. Largest target: Michele Tafoya (oppose, $87,500). 1 spender(s) registered in the last 180 days.

items: The Edge Action Fund: $87,500 — registered 5/26/2026, a new committee

blocks.text: Independent expenditures of $50K+ reported since 10/21/2026 (24/48-hour notices plus regular reports), counting only items not shown in an earlier edition. A shared vendor is a coordination-risk flag, not proof: FEC rules allow common vendors behind a firewall. Generic platforms (ActBlue, Google, postal, banks, broadcasters) are excluded.

footer.coverage_window: FEC RFAI (FRQ) and Form 99 filings received October 21, 2026 onward, as of the Saturday, October 24, 2026 PM edition (250 in window, all previously reported).
footer.sources: FEC filings API; FEC Schedule A/B itemized transactions.
footer.known_gaps: The FEC Schedule A fetch for voided and negative transactions failed with HTTP 504 (query timed out), so voided and negative transactions of $10,000 or more could not be checked in this edition.

apod.title: Rosetta's Selfie
apod.caption: This Rosetta spacecraft selfie was snapped on October 7th, 2014. At the time the comet-chasing spacecraft was about 472 million kilometers from planet Earth, but only 16 kilometers from the surface of comet 67P/Churyumov-Gerasimenko.
